You can only open your own permissions..nso: O ka bula fela ditumelelo tša gago. Kgopela mong/molaodi yo a nago le Manage team go mpshafatša phihlelo.
You can only open your own permissions..tn: O ka bula fela ditetla tsa gago. Kopa mong/molaodi yo o nang le Manage team go ntšhwafatsa phihlelo.
You can only open your own permissions..ts: U nga pfula ntsena mpfumelelo wa wena. Kombela munhu loyi a nga ni xandla/mudyondzi loyi a nga na Manage team ku pfuxeta ku fikelela.
You can only open your own permissions..ve: Ni nga vula fhedzi thendelo dzaṋu. Kombelani munna/mudzulatshidza lye a na Manage team u pfuxa u swikelela.
You can only open your own permissions..ss: Ungavula kuphela imvume yakho. Cel umnikati/umphatsi lonalo-Manage team kuvuselela kufinyelela.
